subject.title: fix(agents): restore ask_user roundtrip in Gateway chats

question: Should existing `coding` and `messaging` profile users receive `ask_user` by default, including unattended Gateway sessions that can pause for an operator response?
rationale: The PR fixes a real availability gap, but changing pre-existing profile contents changes the effective behavior of users who did not opt into a new profile or setting.

options.title: Accept profile expansion
options.body: Keep `ask_user` in both profiles and document that these agents may pause for a structured operator answer.

options.title: Limit the default scope
options.body: Expose `ask_user` only in the profile(s) confirmed appropriate for interactive Gateway runs and retain the existing behavior elsewhere.

options.title: Add an explicit opt-in path
options.body: Preserve current profile behavior and make structured questions available through an explicit existing-policy or profile selection path.

recommendation.title: Accept profile expansion
recommendation.body: Keep `ask_user` in both profiles and document that these agents may pause for a structured operator answer.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this contributor as the author of the active cross-surface implementation and its QA scenario.
